name.description: Site name (may be aliased at the publisher's request).

cattax.description: The taxonomy in use for cat fields.

cat.description: Array of IAB content categories of the site.

sectioncat.description: Array of IAB content categories for the current section.

pagecat.description: Array of IAB content categories for the current page.

page.description: URL of the page where the impression will be shown.

ref.description: Referrer URL that caused navigation to the current page.

search.description: Search string that caused navigation to the current page.

mobile.description: Indicates if the site has been programmed to optimize layout for mobile devices.

privacypolicy.description: Indicates if the site has a privacy policy.

publisher.description: Details about the Publisher of the site.

content.description: Details about the Content within the site.

keywords.description: Comma separated list of keywords about the site.

kwarray.description: Array of keywords about the site.

inventorypartnerdomain.description: A domain for inventory authorization in inventory sharing arrangements.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
